checked_facts.fact: Close placement tries ten one-tile offsets using Tile:isWalkable(), then falls back to the boss tile.
Taint population uses the fixed (33043,32335,15) centre and thresholds 5, 8 and 9, capped at five Bloodjaws.

Both minion kinds count within seventeen same-floor tiles; Bloodjaw spawning is paused by either mechanicsDisabled or the spawn-paused storage; four Pillars remain required even while mechanics are disabled.

remaining: Population phase only; native teleport/agony and complete source-room qualification remain separate requirements.
